title: InvestmentDocumentImport
description: The investment part of POST /v1/documents (ADR-044): a statement or transactions certificate the provider issued, read by the backend (never by a model), checked to add up and kept only when it does. The holder's name and RUT are never read. overview is what get_investments reads from now on (null while nothing usable is imported). Warnings add INVESTMENT_DOCUMENT_UNVERIFIED or INVESTMENT_DOCUMENT_DUPLICATE to the overview's.

duplicate.description: The same document was already imported; nothing changed.
